title: Introduce SLO synchronizer and regional lease guardian (hotfix)
author: Samira Kline
release_notes: Adds a cross-region SLO synchronizer and a regional lease guardian to reduce split-brain during failovers; hotfix preserves KV cache during rapid region transitions. Backwards-compatible. Flagged behind runtime.feature.slo_synchronizer for staged rollout.
description:
Context and motivation: In recent incidents we observed inconsistent SLO accounting across regions during transient network partitions which caused simultaneous soft-evictions and unnecessary tenant throttles. This sequence led to request storms and a prolonged recovery window. This PR introduces two cooperating pieces: (1) an SLO Synchronizer that converges tenant SLO state across active regions with a conservative merge strategy; and (2) a Regional Lease Guardian that prevents concurrent hard eviction/lease actions when regions rejoin. Both pieces are designed to be low-risk and behind a feature flag (runtime.feature.slo_synchronizer).

Goals: reduce duplicate eviction actions during regional rejoins; ensure KV cache preservation during quick failover/rejoin cycles; provide richer telemetry and tracing to debug divergence windows.

What this change does (high-level):
- Adds a periodic SLO state syncer that exchanges compact diffs (tenant id, observed SLO credit, last-update-ts, epoch) between region control planes. The syncer uses a CRDT-inspired last-writer-with-epoch-and-penalty strategy to avoid oscillation.
- Introduces regional lease acquisition with short TTLs (default 8s) and a guardian that ensures only one region is permitted to perform critical eviction/lease-reconcile operations for a tenant cohort at a time.
- Adds conservative backoff when a guardian detects flapping leases: escalate to soft-fallback mode rather than hard-evict which prevents cascade failures.
- Adds a hotfix to the KV cache rebound path: previous rapid failovers could drop in-flight KV snapshots; we now checkpoint last-known KV generation and replay shallow deltas on rejoin.
- Instruments key metrics and traces: slo_sync.delta_bytes, slo_sync.conflict_resolutions, lease_guard.leases_acquired, lease_guard.flaps, kv_replay.replayed_keys. Also wires up a debug view in Console for canary customers.

Design notes and safety:
- Feature-flagged and gated by runtime.feature.slo_synchronizer; default off in production until staged canary.
- Sync payloads are size-limited and sampled for high-volume tenants to bound control-plane bandwidth.
- Lease Guardian intentionally does not change client-facing routing; it only gates internal eviction/lease decisions to avoid split-brain.
- The merge rule: prefer highest epoch, then most recent last-update-ts; on ties apply tenant-weighted penalty to prefer higher-importance tenants staying warm.

Review conversation (condensed):
- Ethan: "This looks good overall. Concerned about lease TTL being too aggressive for high-latency regions. Can we make TTL adaptive based on median RTT in telemetry?" 
- Samira (author): "Good catch — implemented adaptive TTL in guardian.go. Default stays 8s but increases by 2x when median RTT > 250ms. Added unit tests (see f2c4c6d)."
- Priya: "KV replay logic is promising but let's assert we don't accidentally reintroduce stale tokens into cache leading to model corruption." 
- Samira: "Added generation checks and shallow-delta size limit; replay rejects deltas older than the checkpoint generation. See src/runtime/kv/replay.go lines ~120-165."
- Lars: "Agree with telemetry additions. Can we add a sampling tag for tenant cohort to the slo_sync traces?" 
- Samira: "Added tenant_cohort tag and sampling knob; will toggle in canary to keep traces manageable."
- Priya (approval): "Approved after addressing replay gen checks and TTL adaptivity."
- Ethan (approval): "Approved; minor nits in comments fixed in subsequent squash commit."

CI summary:
- build: pass
- unit tests: pass (coverage for new modules at 82%)
- integration (partition_rejoin): pass in CI env with 3-region simulation
- lint: pass
- canary-deploy pipeline: green for staging

Merge outcome: merged via squash-merge by Samira Kline on 2026-02-22. Post-merge tasks: enable runtime.feature.slo_synchronizer in a single canary region for 24h, monitor slo_sync.* and lease_guard.* metrics and the Console debug view. If conflict_resolutions spikes > 5% or lease_guard.flaps > 0.2% escalate to ENG-4120.

Telemetry and observability notes: added dashboards under "SLO / Sync" with prebuilt alerts for sustained delta sizes and lease flapping. Also added a regression eval in the telemetry pipeline to ensure the KV replay doesn’t increase per-token latency by >1.5ms on median.

Rollout plan (short):
1) Enable flag in staging and run partition_rejoin test schedule for 24h
2) Canary enable in region-us-west-2 for a small tenant cohort (+ debug tracing)
3) Expand canary to two more regions after 24h if metrics stable
4) Full enable across regions with 48h watch and rollback path documented in docs/operations/slo_synchronizer_rollout.md

Related items: ENG-4021 (design + rollout), ENG-4120 (incident runbook), SUP-8876 (customer-reported double-evict case).
